Quiz: Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall Story Quiz
Question: When the wall was finished, what did even Nehemiah's enemies perceive?
OptionB: That the work was wrought of God
OptionC: That the wall would soon fall
OptionD: That Nehemiah had bribed the king
Explanation: When the enemies heard and saw it, they were cast down, for they perceived that this work was wrought of God.
